description:
Most people won’t go after what they really want, and that’s exactly why they’ll have an opinion about you doing it.

They’ll question it, pick it apart, tell you to play it safe.

Not because they know better, but because staying where they are feels safer than risking something bigger.

You have to remember, nobody builds statues of the critics.

They build them for the ones who were willing to take the risk, move first, and keep going when it would’ve been easier to stop.
transcript: There's people in your life right now that think you're a dreamer or you're crazy or you lost your mind. That's okay. They don't build statues of critics. And all I know, when we're 100 years old and we look back, we're not going to be happy if we didn't take that last step. So go home and take that step.
spoken_hook_0_3s: There's people in your life right now that think you're a dreamer or you're crazy.
first_sentence: There's people in your life right now that think you're a dreamer or you're crazy or you lost your mind.
